einstellungen.text: You know exactly what Eda promised you. Or you think you do.
The schoolyard, one day before setup. Eda is sitting on the cold stone wall.
"I can't write the texts. Not all of them."
You go hot. You had a deal. She writes all ten texts.
Ten stations, ten texts. Setup is tomorrow. You remember her exact words. Word for word. Totally sure.
The school bell rings. Neither of you gets up.
Eda doesn't say anything. She pulls out her phone and scrolls back. Three weeks. To the night you planned everything.
There it is. One draft. Not a word about all ten.
Your thumb is shaking. You keep scrolling.
Right below it is your reply. Two minutes later. You completely forgot it.
Your memory was so sure. Clear as a photo. And still wrong.
You say, "I'm sorry." No but. No excuse.
Eda nods slowly. She's holding the invitation to the opening. Still sealed.
Then you read your own message out loud. "I'll handle the pressure."
